thag16.10:1.1: Samaṇassa ahū cintā pupphitamhi mahāvane ekaggassa nisinnassa pavivittassa jhāyino: || ||
thag16.10:2.1: aññathā lokanāthamhi tiṭṭhante purisuttame iriyaṃ āsi bhikkhūnaṃ, aññathā dāni dissate. || ||
thag16.10:3.1: sītavātaparittānaṃ, hirikopīnachādanaṃ, mattaṭṭhiyaṃ abhuñjiṃsu santuṭṭhā itarītare. || ||
thag16.10:4.1: paṇītaṃ yadi vā lūkhaṃ appaṃ vā yadi vā bahuṃ yāpanatthaṃ abhuñjiṃsu agiddhā nādhimucchitā. || ||
thag16.10:5.1: jīvitānaṃ parikkhāre bhesajje atha paccaye na bāḷhaṃ ussukā āsuṃ yathā te āsavakkhaye. || ||
thag16.10:6.1: araññe rukkhamūlesu kandarāsu guhāsu ca vivekaṃ anubrūhantā vihiṃsu tapparāyanā, || ||
thag16.10:7.1: nīcaniviṭṭhā subharā mudū atthaddhamānasā abyāsekā amukharā atthacintāvasānugā. || ||
thag16.10:8.1: tato pāsādikaṃ āsi gataṃ bhuttaṃ nisevitaṃ, siniddhā teladhārā va ahosi iriyāpatho. || ||
thag16.10:9.1: sabbāsavaparikkhīṇā mahājhāyī mahāhitā nibbutā dāni te therā, parittā dāni tādisā. || ||
thag16.10:10.1: kusalānañ ca dhammānaṃ paññāya ca parikkhayā sabbākāravarūpetaṃ lujjate jinasāsanaṃ. || ||
thag16.10:11.1: pāpakānañ ca dhammānaṃ kilesānañ ca yo utu upaṭṭhitāvivekāya ye ca saddhammasesakā || ||
thag16.10:12.1: te kilesā pavaḍḍhantā āvisanti bahuṃ janaṃ, kīḷanti maññe bālehi ummattehi va rakkhasā. || ||
thag16.10:13.1: kileseh' ābhibhūtā te tena tena vidhāvitā narā kilesavatthūsu sayaṃgāhe va ghosite, || ||
thag16.10:14.1: pariccajitvā saddhammaṃ aññamaññehi bhaṇḍare, diṭṭhigatāni anventā idaṃ seyyo 'ti maññare. || ||
thag16.10:15.1: dhanañ ca puttaṃ bhariyañ ca chaḍḍayitvāna niggatā kaṭacchubhikkhahetū pi akiccāni nisevare. || ||
thag16.10:16.1: udarāvadehakaṃ bhutvā sayant' uttānaseyyakā, kathā vadenti paṭibuddhā yā kathā satthu garahitā. || ||
thag16.10:17.1: sabbakārukasippāni cittikatvāna sikkhare, avūpasantā ajjhattaṃ sāmaññattho 'ti acchati. || ||
thag16.10:18.1: mattikaṃ telaṃ cuṇṇañ ca udakāsanabhojanaṃ gihīnaṃ upanāmenti ākaṅkhantā bahuttaraṃ. || ||
thag16.10:19.1: dantapoṇaṃ kapiṭṭhañ ca pupphakhādaniyāni ca piṇḍapāte ca sampanne ambe āmalakāni ca, || ||
thag16.10:20.1: bhesajjesu yathā vejjā, kiccākicce yathā gihī, gaṇikā va vibhūsāyaṃ, issare khattiyā yathā,|| ||
thag16.10:21.1: nekatikā vañcanikā kūṭasakkhī avāṭukā bahūhi parikappehi āmisaṃ paribhuñjare. || ||
thag16.10:22.1: lesakappe pariyāye parikappe 'nudhāvitā jīvikatthā upāyena saṃkaḍḍhanti bahuṃ dhanaṃ. || ||
thag16.10:23.1: upaṭṭhapenti parisaṃ kammato no ca dhammato, dhammaṃ paresaṃ desenti lābhato no ca atthato. || ||
thag16.10:24.1: saṃghalābhassa bhaṇḍanti saṃghato paribāhirā, paralābhopajīvantā ahirikā 'va na lajjare. || ||
thag16.10:25.1: nānuyuttā tathā eke muṇḍā saṃghāṭipārutā sambhāvanaṃ yev' icchanti lābhasakkāramucchitā. || ||
thag16.10:26.1: evaṃ nānappayātamhi ni dāni sukaraṃ tathā aphusitaṃ vā phusituṃ phusitaṃ vānurakkhituṃ. || ||
thag16.10:27.1: yathā kaṇṭakaṭṭhānamhi careyya anupāhano satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvāna, evaṃ gāme munī care. || ||
thag16.10:28.1: saritvā pubbake yogī tesaṃ vattam anussaraṃ kiñcāpi pacchimo kālo phuseyya amataṃ padaṃ. || ||
thag16.10:29.1: idaṃ vatvā sālavane samaṇo bhāvitindriyo brāhmaṇo parinibbāyi isi khīṇapunabbhavo 'ti. || || Pārāpariyo thero. uddānaṃ: Adhimutto Pārāpariyo
thag16.10:30.0: Telakāni Raṭṭhapālo Māluṅkya-Selo Bhaddiyo Aṅguli dibbacakkhuko | Pārāpariyo, das' ete Vīsamhi suparikittitā, gāthāyo dve satā honti pañcatālīsa uttarin ti.
